messages:
sam: FYI I'm seeing a reproducible failure in talos-q8 during onboarding on mixed vertical+rtl samples. reproducer and quick notes below. :warning:
anya: thanks — short example?
sam: Minimal case. model="talos-q8" prompt asks for english translation while preserving punctuation and vertical markers.
INPUT:
　⸺日本、中国》
ARABIC_SPAN: الجميل (الجميل)

FP16_OUTPUT:
"Japan, China》 - al-jameel (al-jameel)"

Q8_OUTPUT:
"Japan, China - 》 al-jameel )al-jameel("

sam: Notice the closing vertical bracket ends up swapped and the Arabic parentheses are mirrored and attached to the token instead of being spaced. this happens mostly when the input > 400 tokens.
li-wei: sounds like token index drift around punctuation. any token-id diffs?
sam: small token diff excerpt:```
CHARS: 　 ⸺ 日 本 、 中 国 》
FP16: [4012, 9201, 233, 765, 78, 540, 721, 78, 2]
Q8:  [4012, 9201, 233, 765, 78, 540, 721, 9001, 2]  # 9001 collides with fullwidth comma token id
```
dina: 9001 again? we've seen similar id aliasing in other q8 bringups — could be embedding row collapse or tokenmap remap in quant.
anya: do metrics for the failing slice (vertical+rtl) show a big drop?
sam: yes. local smoke n=180: fp16 BLEU=33.1 chrF=55.0; talos-q8 BLEU=27.2 chrF=48.9. short inputs (<128) are fine.
ci-bot: eval job 7622 created: talos-q8 onboarding smoke (tag:onboard/q8)  https://redwood-evals/7622  delta BLEU -5.9 on vertical-rtl-slice
li-wei: timeline: this model used quantized embeddings (q8-per-channel), and last week runtime PR #4182 changed prefix-cache eviction to prefer chunked KV retention which may interact with fused kernels. plan to bisect kernel heuristics and embedding quant rounding.
anya: quick repro tips?
sam: run `scripts/repro/talos_vertical_rtl_repro.py --repeat 1`. if you pass `--no-prefix-cache` outputs match fp16. also `--kernel=fallback` fixes the mirroring. so it's cache+kernel interaction.
li-wei: I'll run a kernel-bisect and check embedding row L2 differences between fp16 and q8 for punctuation tokens (esp fullwidth comma/bracket).
dina: as a short mitigation we can normalize fullwidth punctuation to ASCII before detok or add a detok remap for the canary. I'd prefer a runtime fix but will gate the detok patch behind a quick smoke.
anya: add a golden test to onboard suite with that minimal example and pin to canary. test id: multilang/gold_vertical_rtl_token_stability.json run=7622-gold.
li-wei: assigning INF-1299. action items: 1) bisect kernel heuristic (me), 2) compare embedding norms and quantization zero point drift (me), 3) add golden sample (dina), 4) temp detok remap (anya).
ci-bot: issue INF-1299 opened: "Talos-q8: punctuation token collapse on mixed vertical+CJK + RTL (prefix-cache x kernel)"  https://redwood-issues/INF-1299
sam: thanks all. I'll post bisect results and the minimal shard link in the ticket. leaving reproducer and eval links there. :pray:
